g.text: Monorepo — billing admission and credit debit
Persist zero-price approved_credit quote expiring in five minutes
Tenant nonblank and known flat nonmetered service?
Read quote; require exact tenant, case-insensitive service match,
Attempt plan debit for all quoted units
Update quote approved_credit and price zero; allow
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Gate checks and plan debit do not reserve a quote in the transaction that
executes an operation. Debit can precede a failed quote write or later operation failure.
Quote updates are unconditional upserts; concurrent admission of the same unconsumed
approved quote is not excluded here. A billing gate is not a native resource grant,
cognition completion or successful effect receipt.
